summary: Module 9 checkpoint. With AGENTS.md in the repository, a coding agent builds a real feature: a question log for /api/ask. You commit its first version alone, review it (green tests that litter the repository, a log write that could fail a request), fix it with tests, prove the golden table did not move, run the real endpoint, and write the PR description with an honest list of risks.
goal: M9 checkpoint: AGENTS.md plus one feature built by an agent, reviewed like a PR.

items.text: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are in the repository and the commands work
Write the prompt with goal, files to look at, rules and done, and give it to your agent on a branch
Commit the agent's first version alone
Review it with the checklist and write the findings: observed or read, and how serious
Fix the findings with tests in a second commit
Run pytest, mypy and the golden table and the real endpoint, and read the log lines
Write the PR description, add the new rule to AGENTS.md, merge and push
